query:
SELECT
                        t.unid,
                        t.author_id,
                        t.content,
                        t.created_at,
                        u.username AS author_username,
                        u.display_name AS author_display_name,
                        u.avatar_url AS author_avatar_url,
                        (t.author_id = $2) AS "is_mine!: bool"
                    FROM tweets t
                    JOIN users u ON u.unid = t.author_id
                    WHERE u.username = $1
                    ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
